camel_example: aliyun dataphin-public GetQualityArchiveTableProgress --region cn-hangzhou --OpTenantId 30001011 --ProgressId d78f0b5c9a1e4f2ab3c6d5e4f7a8b9c0 --version 2023-06-30 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the execution progress and results of an asynchronous task for creating or modifying an exception archive table based on the progress ID. Release version: v6.3.0
description_zh: 根据进度ID查询新建或修改异常归档表异步任务的执行进度与结果，上线版本：v6.3.0
name: GetQualityArchiveTableProgress

parameters.help_en: The progress ID of the asynchronous task, which is returned by the UpsertQualityArchiveTable operation
parameters.help_zh: 异步任务进度ID，由 UpsertQualityArchiveTable 接口返回
parameters.name: progress_id

Data.description_en: The progress details of the asynchronous task

ArchiveTableId.description_en: The ID of the archive table. This parameter is returned after the task succeeds and can be used to switch the active table later
ArchiveTableId.description_zh: 归档表ID，任务成功后返回，可用于后续切换生效表
ArchiveTableId.title_en: 归档表ID，任务成功后返回，可用于后续切换生效表
ArchiveTableId.title_zh: 归档表ID，任务成功后返回，可用于后续切换生效表

ArchiveTableName.description_en: The full name of the archive table. This parameter is returned after the task succeeds. When a table is created, the _exception_data suffix is automatically appended to the name
ArchiveTableName.description_zh: 归档表完整名称，任务成功后返回，新建时包含自动拼接的 _exception_data 后缀
ArchiveTableName.title_en: 归档表完整名称，任务成功后返回，新建时包含自动拼接的 _exception_data 后缀
ArchiveTableName.title_zh: 归档表完整名称，任务成功后返回，新建时包含自动拼接的 _exception_data 后缀

ErrorMessage.description_en: The cause of the task failure. This parameter is returned only when Status is FAILED
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 任务失败原因，仅 Status 为 FAILED 时返回
ErrorMessage.title_en: 任务失败原因，仅 Status 为 FAILED 时返回
ErrorMessage.title_zh: 任务失败原因，仅 Status 为 FAILED 时返回

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
PROGRESS: The task is in progress.
SUCCESS: The task is successful.
FAILED: The task failed.
CANCEL: The task is canceled
Status.description_zh: 任务状态：PROGRESS 执行中，SUCCESS 成功，FAILED 失败，CANCEL 已取消
Status.title_en: 任务状态：PROGRESS 执行中，SUCCESS 成功，FAILED 失败，CANCEL 已取消
Status.title_zh: 任务状态：PROGRESS 执行中，SUCCESS 成功，FAILED 失败，CANCEL 已取消

Message.description_en: The details of the backend exception

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
